independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: source definitions
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: Allain et al. (2007), final Table 1, PDF9; stage prose PDF15; geography PDF7 and Figure 1 PDF3
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Final-model memberships, overlap, stages and study area; initial blue groups are excluded; infant cutoff conflict retained.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: source catch and biomass
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: Allain et al. (2007), Tables 3/5/6, PDF11/14/19; accepted option1 raw JSON
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Raw landings density and biomass. Source missing export (-9999) differs from genuine zero and runtime default. Biomass fallback assumes catch composition/catchability follows model biomass.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: catch classification
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: EEZ_598 workbook Catch/Catch, 2019 landings; Sea Around Us labels and ecological categories
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Exact regional reporting labels and provider common/functional/commercial groups; category size is not an observed individual measurement.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: classic coefficient
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: EEZ_598 workbook Classic PPR/Taxa: saved independent TL/coefficient and recorded provenance
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Independent simple-chain coefficient, TL and source fields are unchanged. Annual tonnes C = catch × saved wet-weight coefficient / 9 once.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: billfish synonyms
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: NCBI Taxonomy: Istiompax indica (13603), Kajikia audax (13721); WoRMS corroborating entries
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Full NCBI entries independently read 2026-09-30: Makaira indica and Tetrapturus audax synonyms. Kajikia entry13721 is separately linked. WoRMS corroboration was previously indexed/read in EEZ_941 review with direct timeout/403; not claimed as a fresh full retrieval here.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: FAO tuna ecology
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: FAO: introduction to tuna and billfish biology (Y0490E), vertical habitat and life histories
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Full relevant text read 2026-09-30: bigeye/bluefin deep diving, albacore intermediate habitat; supports weak analogue only, not caught-size shares.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: FAO family identification
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: FAO historical Scombridae identification sheet; retained Chirocentridae evidence
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Scombridae PDF5 independently read 2026-09-30, including Scomber/Scomberomorus/Thunnus/Katsuwonus/Acanthocybium. Chirocentrus coastal-pelagic ecology is retained EEZ_941 source evidence, independently compared with PNG provider categories; no claim of regional composition.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: FAO octopod ecology
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: FAO identification guide Y4160E, printed pp.217–219 (PDF2–4), Argonautidae/Bolitaenidae/Octopodidae
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: Relevant PDF2–4 independently read 2026-09-30: surface pelagic Argonautidae, meso/bathypelagic Bolitaenidae and benthic Octopodidae. Supports full order-level candidate review and actual habitat mismatch; no composition shares.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: diagnostics
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: Exact accepted option1 retained full direct diagnostic returns and group × source matrices
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: GE/TE/With Egestion WARN, strict mass balance false, PP budget OK. Full source matrix checked independently in this review; no fresh solver executed.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: reconstruction provenance
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: Original final source reconstruction audit and selected option1 provenance
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: 31 source groups plus synthetic import; loader conventions, source initial/final distinctions, native multistanza and author-confirmation limits; original final reconstruction FAIL differs from accepted variant.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: stage data search
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: Retained 2026-09-29 WCPFC/SPC public size-data search and Papua New Guinea 2020 annual report
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: No relevant all-fleet PNG-EEZ 2019 caught-mass shares at exact source stage thresholds recovered. This is not evidence such data do not exist.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: FAO lobster taxonomy
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: FAO Marine Lobsters of the World Vol13 (1991), Palinuridae/Panulirus
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: 2026-09-30 catalogue family/genera reviewed; provider benthic lobster reporting differs from source epipelagic forage.

independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.label: FAO shark taxonomy
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.title: FAO Field Identification Guide to Sharks and Rays (2005), printed45/PDF22, Carcharhinidae/Galeocerdo/Prionace
independent_taxonomy_ecology_sources.supports: 2026-09-30 relevant full page read: historical Carcharhinidae includes Galeocerdo and Prionace, bridging tiger shark and complete reported family to source pools. No regional composition measurement.

allocation_decision: No applicable observed regional caught-mass weights recovered. Complete source model catches, then complete biological biomass, supply explicit Medium composition assumptions; separate membership confidence can be weaker. Accepted infantSKJ uncaught exception remains explicit. This bounded search does not establish that data do not exist.
